운동이 필요하다는 사실은 누구나 알고 있습니다. 하지만 규칙적인 운동을: Everyone knows exercise is necessary. Yet keeping a regular routine is hard. Exercise feels like a chore, and the same routine, the same posture and the same numbers get boring fast. People stop not because they dislike moving, but because they have not yet met a scene that makes them want to move again.
The moment you think “I want to try that,” exercise gets hot again. A step-back in the final minute, footwork slicing across the ring, a runner holding pace to the finish line: scenes that steal your gaze make you want to move the instant you see them.
Newton의 타깃은 멋진 움직임에 끌리고, 내가 있는 곳에서 바로 도전: Newton's target is the light-active user drawn to great movement and eager to try it right where they are. People who watch running crews, boxing shorts and basketball highlights and feel like giving it a go. For them, exercise is not homework but an aesthetic to save and follow.
프로의 스텝, 크리에이터의 루틴, 동호회 고수의 한 수까지. 따라 해 보:
A pro's steps, a creator's routine, a club veteran's signature move. Any movement you want to follow becomes a Challenge Pack. Pick the Pack that pulls you now and Newton unfolds it as cues you can follow. Saved movement continues onto walls, floors and outdoor ground, becoming a challenge you can start in the space you are in.
▶ See Newton's full play journey
웨어러블 로봇 Newton을 중심으로 구성된 하드웨어 시스템은 반복되는: Built around the wearable robot Newton, the hardware system is an exercise partner that fills repetitive days with the joy of new challenges. It reads and analyzes your movement in real time to provide optimized physical assistance, and unfolds a field where anyone can take on great moves anytime, anywhere.
Newton은 IMU 센서를 비롯한 다중 감각 센서를 통해 사용자의 움직: Newton is a wearable robot that understands and assists the user's movement in real time through multiple sensors including an IMU. A compact tension structure built on BLDC motors delivers optimized physical assistance, minimizing strain on joints and muscles so anyone can focus on the joy of movement in a comfortable, stable state.
Core 유닛은 Challenge Pack의 움직임을 레이저 빔 스캐닝(: The Core unit projects Challenge Pack movement into your space using laser beam scanning (LBS). Linked with Newton and Station, it lays visual guides across desks, indoor walls and outdoor ground, helping you follow the moves you wanted to try right in front of you.
Station은 Newton을 충전하고 보관하는 거치형 허브입니다. 운동: Station is the docking hub that charges and stores Newton. When you are not exercising it checks hardware status and adjusts where the Core unit sits and its projection angle indoors. The next movement is prepared here, and putting on the wearable robot leads straight into a new challenge.
책상 앞에 오래 앉아 몸이 굳어 갈 때, Station은 지금 끌릴 만한: When your body stiffens after long hours at a desk, Station briefly shows a Challenge Pack that might pull you in. Boxing slips and punch highlights you learned as a kid spread across the space, and the projected start button draws out the urge to move again. The moment you press it, the workout you had to do becomes play you want to try right now.
Pack을 고르면 방 안의 벽면이 조용한 링이 됩니다. 스트레칭으로 굳은: Pick a Pack and the wall of your room becomes a quiet ring. Stretching opens a stiff body and prepares you to move without pressure indoors. You learn the rhythm by following a master's moves on the wall, then wake up real-match senses with a short sparring. A first play completed without pressure leaves the wish to start another move.
집에서 한 번 움직여 본 감각은 피드 속 러닝을 그냥 넘기지 못하게 만듭: Once you have moved at home, you can no longer scroll past a run in your feed. Today you pick the running-mate Pack with Sean and head outside. Following the light that continues under your feet, you match pace and beat, and when the rhythm wavers, Boost On adds power to the next step. The moment the run you watched in your feed starts under your feet, a familiar routine becomes play you want to follow.
Time spent moving alone now brings friends' play to mind. Today's Pack is Stephen Curry's step-back. Newton lays the first step, the back-step and the return rhythm on the ground, and Press On adds heavy resistance on the return to wake up agility. Rhythm learned alone grows into the wish to step onto the court with friends, and exercise quietly becomes a sport you fall into together.
플레이가 끝난 뒤에도 오늘의 움직임은 다음을 향해 이어집니다. 리포트는: Even after play ends, today's movement continues toward the next. The report shows how close you came to the play you dreamed of, expanding the achievement into new possibilities. Newton, which ran with you, charges on the Station, and the fabric parts touched by sweat are washed and stored fresh. Today's sensation remains as anticipation for the next challenge.
Newton은 스포츠를 시작하고 도전하는 경험에서 출발합니다. 하지만 그: Newton starts from the experience of beginning and challenging a sport. But at its center is not a single discipline; it is a structure that lets you start unfamiliar movement at your body's own pace. That possibility extends beyond running, boxing and basketball to learning balance and recovering the sense of walking again. So that anyone can trust their turn and take on new movement.

가정의 냉방은 사람의 체감을 기준으로 이루어집니다. 같은 공간에서 여름을:
Home cooling is tuned to how people feel.
The dog sharing the same room in summer is left out.
We focused on the dog that spends the summer at home with us.
선풍기 바람이 강아지에게 실제로 시원한지 확인하는 것에서 리서치를 시작했: Research began by checking whether fan air actually feels cool to a dog.
강아지는 땀을 흘리지 않고 혀와 발바닥으로 수분을 증발시켜 체온을 낮춥니:
Dogs do not sweat; they cool down by evaporating moisture through the tongue and paw pads.
So direct airflow from the front barely feels cool to them.
A cooling product designed around a dog's traits is needed.
기존 선풍기는 이 기본적인 특성을 고려하지 않습니다. 강아지를 위한 바람:
Existing fans ignore this basic trait.
The absence of airflow made for dogs is the first problem.
보호자가 외출하면 문제는 더 커집니다. 선풍기를 켜두면 감전·화재가 걱정:
The problem grows when the owner goes out.
Leaving a fan on raises the risk of electric shock and fire; leaving the AC on raises the bill.
There is no way for a dog to stay cool and safe when home alone.
사람 중심으로 설계된 선풍기는 함께 있을 때마다 세기와 방향을 따로 맞춰:
A fan designed around people needs its strength and direction adjusted every time the two are together.
It cannot meet two different comfort conditions in one room.
강아지가 함께 있는 공간에서, 사람과 마찬가지로 안전하고 지속적인 시원함: We set the challenge as providing the dog, in the room it shares with people, the same safe and continuous coolness.
시원한 곳을 찾아 이동하며 체온을 조절하는 강아지의 행동 특성과 환경 반: We propose an AI air multiplier based on how dogs regulate body heat by moving to cooler spots and on how they respond to their environment.
직장인 유정씨(32)의 말티즈 몽이는 하루 대부분을 혼자 집에서 보냅니다:
Yujeong (32), an office worker, has a Maltese named Mong who spends most of the day home alone.
Sensitive to heat, Mong wanders the living room every summer looking for a cool spot.
유정씨는 \"강아지가 스스로 오게 만드는 선풍기\"라는 문구를 보고 CO: Yujeong sees the line “a fan that makes the dog come on its own,” orders COMONG and sets it up.
앱을 처음 실행하면 반려견 정보를 입력합니다. AI가 몽이에게 맞는 바람:
On first launch the app asks for the dog's profile.
AI automatically recommends the airflow strength and floor temperature that suit Mong.
출근 시간이 되면 AI 컴패니언이 일정 패턴을 읽고 외출 모드를 제안합니:
At commute time the AI companion reads her schedule pattern and suggests Away mode.
COMONG cools the floor zone where Mong stays to 22°C and creates a gentle circulating breeze.
더위를 피해 거실을 서성이던 몽이는 COMONG이 만든 시원한 바닥 존으: Mong, who used to pace the living room to escape the heat, now moves on his own to the cool floor zone COMONG has made.
하단 온도 센서가 맞춘 시원한 바닥 위에서 몽이는 은은한 바람을 느끼며: On the cool floor set by the bottom temperature sensor, Mong stays and enjoys the gentle breeze.
At work, Yujeong checks on Mong through the app.
Mong's state is easy to check in the app.
퇴근 후 저녁을 준비하는 사이 몽이가 더위를 느끼기 시작합니다. 카메라:
After work, while dinner is being prepared, Mong starts to feel the heat.
The camera sensor catches it.
The camera sensor detects panting, judges it as a heat response and turns on the AC.
Coolness that fits Mong is kept while saving energy, and the owner gets a notification.
After preparing the meal, Yujeong moves COMONG next to the kitchen.
위쪽은 유정씨를 위한 직접풍, 아래쪽은 몽이를 위한 바닥풍이 동시에 작동:
Direct airflow above for Yujeong and floor airflow below for Mong run at the same time.
Two different kinds of coolness coexist in one room.
잠들기 전 몽이가 머문 시간과 절약된 에너지를 확인합니다. 보호자와 반려:
Before bed she checks how long Mong stayed and how much energy was saved.
A safe and cool summer for both owner and dog.
The display and controls sit at the user's eye level, out of the dog's reach.
A hidden display on top of the product controls COMONG.
상단 흡입구와 직접풍 팬은 오픈형 구조입니다. 카메라와 지면 온도 센서가:
The top intake and the direct-airflow fan are an open structure.
When the camera and floor temperature sensor detect heat, the intake opens automatically.
모터와 필터가 제품 상단에 위치합니다. 하단으로 간접풍을 보내기 위한 흡:
The motor and filters sit at the top of the product.
The intake and dust filter that send indirect airflow downward are located at the top.
위에서 빨아들인 공기가 아래로 나가며 반려견 맞춤의 확장된 에어 서큘레이: Air drawn in from above flows out below, drawing an extended air circulation tailored to the dog.
외출 중 사고를 막기 위해 오뚝이 원리로 설계했습니다. 기울어져도 되돌아:
Designed on the self-righting principle to prevent accidents while the owner is away.
It returns when tilted, and a damper softens the return.

Created by a team of 5 as a 2026 Samsung Design Membership MEP exhibition piece, with responsibility for UX strategy, scenarios, IA, projection GUI, and development of a validation simulator (UX 100%).
Samsung Electronics CDO 시니어를 위한 AI 컴패니언,:
Samsung Electronics CDO
An AI companion for seniors,
TeddyBot
삼성전자 CDO 과제로 2026년 3월부터 5월까지 3인 팀이 진행했습니: A Samsung Electronics CDO brief carried out by a team of 3 from March to May 2026. Based on the stories of 14 seniors and public statistics, the team proposed a two-piece AI companion, a home unit plus a portable for outings, that protects the unsteady daily lives of mid-to-late-life seniors. Contributed to UX research and planning (40% contribution) and was responsible for insight synthesis, passive scenario planning, and scenario video production.
Issue Raising 세 개의 빈자리가 서로를 키우는 구조:
Issue Raising
Three gaps
that feed one another
대한민국은 65세 이상이 다섯 명 중 한 명인 초고령 사회에 들어섰습니다: Korea has become a super-aged society, where one in five people is 65 or older. Living alone and bereavement leave more hours that family cannot reach, social networks shrink, and seniors hold devices without keeping up in using them. Seeing these three gaps as feeding one another, the team defined the need for a new companion, not a smartphone, to fill the hours people cannot reach.
노인실태조사와 디지털정보격차 실태조사 등 공공 데이터 9종으로 시니어 지: Nine public datasets, including the National Survey of Older Koreans and the Digital Divide Survey, mapped the senior landscape. In March 2026, 10 people from pre-senior to mid-senior age took part in 30 to 40-minute semi-structured interviews in person and by phone. Four late seniors aged 85+, hard to meet due to mobility and cognitive limits, were supplemented with GPT personas grounded in government statistics and research papers.
Active Needs 스스로를 노인으로 보지 않는 시니어:
Active Needs
Seniors who don't
see themselves as old
시니어가 생각하는 노년의 시작은 71.6세로, 법적 기준보다 6.6세 높: Seniors place the start of old age at 71.6, 6.6 years above the legal threshold and rising every year. They named travel and hobbies as the activities they hope for in later life and share photos and videos over messengers, showing active desires rather than being objects of care.
Two Axes & Paradox 75세 이후 달라지는 몸과 관계:
Two Axes & Paradox
Body and relationships change after 75
75세를 기점으로 만성질환 복합이환이 크게 늘고, 성별에 따라 관계망이: From age 75, multimorbidity of chronic diseases rises sharply, and the way social networks shrink differs by gender. Most wanted to stay in their current home apart from their children, yet a paradox emerged: emotional exchange narrows and loneliness deepens in later life.
Three Disconnections 활기를 막는 세 가지 끊김:
Three Disconnections
Three disconnections that drain vitality
인터뷰 목소리와 통계를 하루의 시간대에 겹쳐 보며 활기가 끊기는 지점을: Overlaying interview voices and statistics onto the hours of a day split the points where vitality breaks into three. After retirement, not knowing what to do or how cuts off new experiences; as body and cognition weaken together, the familiar day becomes unsteady; and as networks shrink, memories are swallowed alone. As a reason for not taking part in leisure, not knowing how was cited 3.2 times more often than health.
Life Journey 끊김이 겹겹이 쌓이는 중·후기 노년:
Life Journey
Mid-to-late life, where disconnections pile up
세 끊김은 은퇴, 노화, 관계 축소 같은 라이프 저니의 전환점마다 생깁니: The three disconnections arise at each turning point of the life journey, such as retirement, aging, and shrinking relationships. In early old age only one axis loosens; after 75 the daily-upkeep disconnection is added, and after 85 the relationship-and-memory disconnection. This compound gap, which no single feature can resolve, became TeddyBot's core target.
Market Gap 기존 솔루션이 닿지 않는 세 영역:
Market Gap
Three areas existing solutions don't reach
끊김이 가장 두꺼운 구간에서 시장이 비워 둔 영역을 세 가지로 좁혔습니다: In the stretch where disconnections are thickest, the areas the market has left empty were narrowed to three. People in their 70s and older face a wide gap in digital access and use, calling for a new form operated by voice instead of typing. Seniors go out 4.5 times a week, yet outdoor falls account for 56.4% of falls, leaving a gap for a companion that comes along on outings.
Competitors 돌봄·안심에 모인 기존 로봇 6종:
Competitors
Six existing robots focused on care and reassurance
ElliQ, 효돌, LOVOT, PARO, BOCCO emo, 다솜이를: ElliQ, Hyodol, LOVOT, PARO, BOCCO emo, and Dasomi were compared by functional area. Three to five of the six already offered care and reassurance functions such as emotional, health, and safety support, but none supported experience expansion such as challenge, memories, and connection, or portable companionship on outings.
Bridge 세 갈래 리서치가 가리킨 한 지점:
Bridge
One point all three research strands pointed to
정량 데이터, 14명의 인터뷰, 시장 지형이 공통으로 가리킨 지점을 컨셉: The point that quantitative data, 14 interviews, and the market landscape all pointed to became the starting point of the concept: adding the value of experience expansion, physicality, and mobility on top of the care and reassurance the market has already established.
Target 연령이 아닌 성향으로 나눈 두 타깃:
Target
Two targets split by disposition, not age
같은 중·후기 시니어라도 꺼지지 않는 불씨로 도전하는 Active Cha: Even within mid-to-late-life seniors, the team distinguished the Active Challenger, who takes on challenges with an ember that never goes out, and the Passive Isolated, who wants to keep the warmth of their own day. For the Active, information and saving face were the barriers; for the Passive, it was not wanting to burden their children.
Catch the Flame은 스치는 흥미를 붙잡아 시작의 문턱을 낮추고: Catch the Flame captures passing interests and lowers the threshold for starting. Keep the Light detects subtle wobbles in daily life early to support independence. Warm the Bond stores memories worth sharing in their time context to close the distance between people.
Positioning & Character 곁에서 비추되 주체는 시니어:
Positioning & Character
Lighting the way alongside,
with the senior in charge
명령을 수행하는 음성 비서와 시니어를 보호 대상으로 보는 돌봄 로봇 사이: Between voice assistants that carry out commands and care robots that treat seniors as people to protect, TeddyBot takes a position that lights the way alongside while leaving decisions to the senior. Five traits were set: respect, patience, gentleness, warm continuity, and non-directiveness, along with speech principles of calling users by their own name and putting only one piece of information in each sentence.
아기·인형 스타일은 보호 대상이라는 인상을, 가전·스피커 스타일은 교감: Baby and doll styles suggest an object of protection, while appliance and speaker styles leave only function without connection, so a refined companion form between the two was chosen. The criteria were gentle curves that are pleasant for seniors to touch and a body-warm outer shell.
Tactile Interaction 촉각으로 읽고 몸으로 답하는 인터랙션:
Tactile Interaction
Reading by touch,
answering with the body
꾹꾹 누름, 쓰다듬음, 톡톡 두드림, 꽉 쥠을 각각 다른 감정 신호로 읽: Pressing, stroking, tapping, and squeezing are each read as different emotional signals. TeddyBot answers by expanding and contracting in time with breathing, warming from 36℃ to 37.5℃, and moving its head, and turning it upside down puts it to sleep, preserving the right to refuse.
Two-piece 집 안과 외출을 잇는 2피스 구조:
Two-piece
A two-piece structure linking home and outings
거실에 머무는 홈 본체와 옷깃에 다는 포터블로 나눴습니다. 아침에 분리한: The product is split into a home unit that stays in the living room and a portable worn on the collar. The portable, detached in the morning, goes through the outing together, and when it docks with the home unit in the evening, the day's context builds up in the home unit. With the home unit alone, it would remain an AI that only knows the inside of the house, so the portable was made a core component.

Persona · Active Senior
A day with Misook Jung, 71

Active Scenario 01
A scenario where humming
turns into creation

Home unit and portable reviewed at actual size

Senior LLM Principles 시니어 LLM 인터랙션 설계 원칙:
Senior LLM Principles
LLM interaction design principles for seniors
테디봇의 말투와 응답 방식은 시니어 LLM 연구를 근거로 정했습니다. L: TeddyBot's speech and response style were grounded in research on LLMs for seniors. In Liu et al. (2023), intention to use rose the more it was perceived as a companion, and in Wang and Lo (2025), older adults were actually more satisfied with responses delayed by 10 to 60 seconds. A scalable visual language

Abstract, tactile visuals without a fixed form became easier to vary as light and texture were added, making them well suited to expressing undefined AI states such as thoughts and emotions. Systems that start from small units like dots and lines, as at IBM and MIT, extended their symbols consistently into interaction and UI, and a simple shape read as a character with just a minimal cue such as eyes.

직접 AI를 호출하는 경험은 여전히 어색하고, 때로는 부정적으로 인식됩니: Calling AI directly still feels awkward and is sometimes seen negatively. 70% of users felt that "the act of calling AI itself is a hassle." Meanwhile, 78% of users want an AI that reads the situation and helps first. In the end, help from an AI that comes when called is always one beat late. What AI needs now is a "proactive sense": understanding and responding before the user asks.
Half a Step Ahead 호출이 아닌 등장, 사용자를 반 걸음 앞:
Half a Step Ahead
Appearing, not called:
Proactive AI that helps half a step ahead

Rather than a passive system that only moves when told "Hey, AI," it should understand the user's context and approach half a step ahead. AI is redefined not as something to call, but as a moment of appearance. Showing up on its own when needed and helping within the flow without being asked: that is the proposed Proactive AI interaction.
When Help Lacks Context, It Feels Intrus:
When Help Lacks Context, It Feels Intrusive
Kindness without context becomes discomfort
AI가 먼저 다가온다고 해서 모두 환영받는 것은 아닙니다. 맥락 없이 앞: An AI that approaches first is not always welcome. Help that steps in without context feels unfamiliar and sometimes uncomfortable. According to the survey, only 9.6% of users preferred AI that acts autonomously. Many still hesitate at AI's "proactive intervention" because of privacy concerns, distrust of the system, and the desire to decide for themselves. In the end, AI's kindness only means something when it is grounded in context.

A user workshop to find the "right moment" for AI intervention

Participants used card sorting to separate situations that call for intervention from uncomfortable ones, and dot voting to set priorities and limits. 5-phase analysis

Input 그룹 인터뷰도, 오타 섞인 원문도 그대로:
Input
Group interviews

The Cake 지구 반대편에서도 맞는 박자:

In sync, even from the other side of the world

Survey
They know, but still can't start
자주 미루는 193명 설문에서 마감 직전 결과물이 기대에 못 미쳤고(51: In a survey of 193 frequent procrastinators, last-minute work fell short of expectations (51%) and caused high stress (50%). The biggest reason starting was hard was difficulty making up their minds (59.6%).
Interview & Desk Research 작은 행동, 여유 시간,:
Interview & Desk Research
Small actions, buffer time, immersive environment
9명 인터뷰와 데스크 리서치에서 세 가지를 얻었습니다. 작은 행동이 시작: Interviews with 9 people and desk research yielded three insights. A small action triggers getting started (Ferrari's procrastination theory); people underestimate how long things take, so buffer time must be built in (planning fallacy); and once started, they need an immersive environment such as music or a place.
Hypothesis 여유 있게 시작하고, 몰입을 이어 가면:
Hypothesis

Team Onboarding App 새 팀의 첫날, 서로를 알고 팀 규칙:
Team Onboarding App
A new team's first day:
an onboarding app for getting to know each other and setting team rules
삼성디자인멤버십은 과제마다 팀이 새로 꾸려져 2년 동안 팀이 8번 바뀝니: In the Samsung Design Membership, teams are reformed for every project, so teams change 8 times over 2 years. Starting from the problem of beginning every first day again with introductions and role assignment, this app turns the first day into collaboration setup time with a 5-step, choose-only onboarding and a team dashboard. Planned, designed, and developed solo over two days starting May 1, 2026 (100% contribution), and demonstrated live at the Membership's vibe coding seminar.
Problem 2년간 8번 바뀌는 팀, 매번 처음부터 다시 하는 자기소개:
Problem
Teams that change 8 times in 2 years,
introductions from scratch every time
팀은 약 2개월 단위로 매칭, 첫날 온보딩, 프로젝트, 해산을 거치고 이: Teams go through matching, first-day onboarding, the project, and disbanding roughly every 2 months, and this cycle repeats 8 times over 2 years. Each time, introductions, sharing work styles, scheduling, and agreeing on roles started over from scratch. Team member interviews surfaced three recurring frustrations: writing introductions takes a lot of time every time, the work styles shared are not actually used when assigning roles, and people end up second-guessing themselves after seeing the first posts. In real team chat rooms, the same requests and apologies repeated with every project.
Define 첫 만남마다 반복되던 질문을 네 갈래로:
Define
Recurring first-meeting questions, sorted into four groups
인터뷰에서 모은 첫 만남의 질문을 내용별로 묶어 보니 네 갈래로 정리됐습: Grouping the first-meeting questions gathered in interviews by content produced four categories. Signature work and strengths became personal info; working style and feedback preferences became team understanding; roles and decision-making became collaboration standards; and core time and meeting times became team operation standards. Each category was mapped to one screen feature: My Work card, Work Style card, Team Align board, and Core Time and Kickoff card, so that as each person answers, the whole team's answers gather in one place.
Onboarding 쓰는 대신 고르는 5단계 온보딩:
Onboarding
5-step onboarding: choose instead of write
빈칸에 쓰는 부담을 없애기 위해 모든 질문을 선택형으로 바꿨습니다. 프로: To remove the burden of filling in blanks, every question was made multiple choice. Users pick the project type and team size, select teammates by name from a list, and profiles are color-coded automatically by role. For work style, users add a one-line reason right after choosing a keyword, so their style carries into actual collaboration standards. In the final step, everyone's answers are combined into the team's collaboration agreement.
Team Dashboard 팀의 오늘을 한눈에 보는 홈:
Team Dashboard
A home showing the team's day at a glance
After onboarding, agreed rules, core time, and teammates' status come together on a single home screen. On the home screen, teammate characters run together to show progress, and tapping the rules, schedule, or members items leads to each screen. Core time overlays everyone's available hours so meeting times can be set right away, and the rules agreed on the first day stay saved by item so they can be revisited during the project.

AI Used Process
Planning with ChatGPT,

Characters
Four characters resembling PL, ID, UX, and VD members
기본 캐릭터 하나를 두고 직군마다 색과 소품만 바꿔 달라고 요청해, 멤버: Starting from one base character and requesting changes only to color and props for each role, four characters were made to resemble the Membership's four roles. Validation
2D characters walking the Membership hallway seen every day

Data Pipeline 사진과 직군 표만 넣으면 58명이 걸어 다니는:

Just add photos and a role table, and 58 people walk around
멤버십 동기 58명을 모두 캐릭터로 걷게 하려고, 얼굴 사진은 폴더에 넣: To have all 58 Membership peers walk as characters, face photos were placed in a folder and names and roles (27 ID, 31 UX) were written one per line in an MD file. Claude Code finds each person by file name, reads the role from the table, and assembles a character in the matching role color. One MD line is one character, so adding people only means adding files, with no changes to the screen code.
Lettering · Icon · Sound · GUI 게임처럼 통통 튀:
Lettering · Icon · Sound · GUI
A full set of bouncy, game-like screens
레터링은 게임 간판 레퍼런스와 허용 팔레트 4색을 기준으로 타이틀, 버튼: Lettering aligned the tone of titles, buttons, and in-game text based on game signage references and a 4-color allowed palette. For icons, 21 original line icons were passed in at once, keeping their meaning and shape while changing only the material to a game style. For sound, background music, button taps, and cheering applause moments were separated, with a sound of different character chosen for each. For the GUI, the Jua typeface, glossy buttons, cream cards, and letter spacing were bundled into one set of CSS variables so the tone stays consistent as screens are added.

Samsung Electronics MX AI 시대를 위한 One UI:
Samsung Electronics MX
One UI improvement ideas for the AI era
삼성전자 MX사업부 과제로 2025년 3월부터 5월까지 진행했습니다(기여: A Samsung Electronics MX Business project carried out from March to May 2025 (30% contribution, UX research and UI design). The Galaxy S25's AI features and 5 default apps were tested from a Gen Z perspective, leading to proposed improvements applicable across multiple apps.
Goal AI 경험의 경쟁력을 위한 공통 개선:
Goal
Shared improvements for a competitive AI experience
AI 기능이 들어간 모바일 경험이 보편화되면서, 갤럭시도 AI 사용 경험: As AI-powered mobile experiences became mainstream, Galaxy needed to compete on AI experience. Competitors' AI use cases and AI-related components were researched together.
3 Areas 검색, 생성형 AI, 앱 간 이동:
3 Areas
Search, generative AI, and moving between apps
이 세 가지 경험을 중심으로 페인포인트를 찾고 AI를 활용한 아이디어를: Pain points were identified around these three experiences, and AI-driven ideas were proposed.
검색어를 입력한 뒤 앱을 열려면 화면 맨 위까지 손을 올려야 했고, 갤러: After typing a search term, opening an app required reaching all the way to the top of the screen, and searching for a person in Gallery mixed photos of that person with photos containing their name as text.
Solution 검색 의도에서 다음 행동까지:
Solution
From search intent to the next action
입력한 키워드에 맞는 후속 행동을 바로가기로 제안하고, 검색 결과를 분류: Shortcuts suggest follow-up actions matching the entered keyword, AI proactively suggests filters to sort search results, and in Gallery, smart action chips reduce filtering steps.
다시 생성하면 이전 작업이 초기화되어 편집 과정을 알 수 없었고, 결과를: Regenerating reset previous work, leaving no record of the editing process, and continuing to refine a result meant turning the AI feature on again and starting a new step.
Adobe Firefly의 생성 내역, Apple Playground의: Drawing on Adobe Firefly's generation history and Apple Playground's style history, prompts, sketches, and selected objects stay in a bottom panel for quick edits, and a history flow stacks AI edits in order.
Continuous Editing 하나의 바에서 이어지는 편집:
Continuous Editing
Continuous editing from a single bar
텍스트와 이미지 편집 기능을 하단 내비게이션 바 하나로 모아, 저장하고: Text and image editing tools are combined into a single bottom navigation bar, enabling continuous editing without saving and reloading.
Problem, 기여도 80% 이상 다음 행동을 모르는 앱 중심 UI:
Problem, 80%+ contribution
App-centric UI that doesn't know the next action
고정된 앱 중심 UI는 사용자의 다음 행동을 고려하지 못해, 필요한 정보: A fixed, app-centric UI could not anticipate users' next actions, forcing them to switch between apps to find information. In complex situations the flow between apps broke down, and designing future cross-app experiences required scenarios that read the context first.
Predictive Suggestion 필요한 순간, 다음 행동을 먼저:
Predictive Suggestion
Cards that suggest the next action
at the moment it's needed
대화 맥락을 읽어 관련 파일을 하단 패널에 추천하고, 링크를 넣으면 요약: It reads conversation context to recommend related files in a bottom panel, creates a summary note as soon as a link is added, and suggests alarms based on sleep status and weather. It detects interrupted actions, such as stopping mid-note or forgetting to send a message, and picks them back up, and when circumstances change, such as travel, driving, or paying abroad, it organizes the needed information into cards.
Now Brief 예측된 하루가 아니라, 시뮬레이션된 하루:
Now Brief
Not a predicted day,
but a simulated day
하루 전체를 미리 시뮬레이션해 가장 나은 흐름을 고르고, 그 흐름에 필요: Now Brief was redesigned to simulate the entire day in advance, choose the best flow, and complete the preparation that flow requires ahead of time.
Canvas Workspace 페이지 전환 없이 한 화면에서 이어지는 작:
Canvas Workspace
Work that continues on one screen
without switching pages
필요한 앱들이 한 화면에 연결되는 도화지형 작업 공간입니다. 페이지를 옮: A canvas-style workspace where the needed apps connect on a single screen. Users can piece together information from multiple apps and work continuously without changing pages.
More Scenarios 통화와 사진, 키보드, 연락처까지 확장한 시나:
More Scenarios
Scenarios extended to calls, photos,
keyboard, and contacts
통화 중 콘텐츠 공유, 사진 저장 뒤 분류 제안, 키보드 입력에 맞춘 정: The same principle was extended to other apps: sharing content during calls, suggesting categories after saving photos, showing information based on keyboard input, travel prep and schedule catch-up, and reminders for forgotten contacts. Finally, agents that organize screens by topic and agents that communicate with each other sketch the cross-app experience a few years ahead.
